description: Defines functions to generate synthetic property fields and values for posts, channels, teams, and authors in Mattermost, likely used for testing or data simulation.

methods.name: getSyntheticPropertyFields
methods.description: Returns a set of synthetic property field definitions for a given group ID.

methods.name: getSyntheticPropertyValues
methods.description: Returns an array of synthetic property values for a post, given various identifiers and timestamps.
